against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

> **Historical scope:** This card records the narrow 2024 diagnostic design, its closeout, and what that evidence justified at that time. It is not a statement of current Helio Start policy or current operating rules.

## Purpose
Test whether high-effort post-admission setup blockers reflected a distinct external-system authority need, product-guidance need, or both. The diagnostic was approved instead of an onboarding rebuild. The original eight cases were a signal to investigate, not a basis for changing operations before prospective evidence matured.

## Enrollment and observation window
- Enroll the **first 60 workspaces admitted from October 1 through October 28, 2024**.
- Stop diagnostic enrollment at the 60th qualifying admission; retain that admission timestamp. Later admissions remain outside the diagnostic. The October 28 date is the cutoff for reaching 60, not a reason to enroll beyond 60.
- Observe each enrolled workspace prospectively through a complete **45-day post-admission support window**.

## Prospective case classification
Classify each relevant support case as one of:
- **External access or authority** — an owner-level permission, network-allowlist, or other external-system authority action is required.
- **Product guidance** — help is needed understanding or using the product, without an external-authority blocker.
- **Mixed** — both an external-authority action and product guidance materially contribute.

Keep classifications grounded in the observed support chronology; do not infer category from admin proof or connector authentication alone.

## Tracked support outcomes
For each support case/workspace, record:
- resolution time;
- substantive repeat contacts; and
- post-admission human support minutes.

Keep the 45-day window complete for each enrolled workspace before treating the diagnostic as closed, except for the conditional close date below.

## Completion rule
A **December 12, 2024** close was available only if all 60 workspaces had been enrolled by October 28. If the cohort did not reach 60 by the cutoff, wait until every enrolled workspace has a complete 45-day support window before closing. Reaching 60 did not itself end observation or authorize an operating change.

## Historical closeout (December 12, 2024)
All 60 enrolled workspaces had complete 45-day windows. Seventeen contacted support, accumulating **486 post-admission human minutes**:

| Prospective support category | Cases/workspaces | Human minutes | Median resolution time | Substantive repeat contacts |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| External authority (owner-level permission, network allowlist, or other external-authority action) | 7 | 301 | 3.6 business days | 12 |
| Product guidance | 10 | 185 | 1.4 days | 6 |

Every authority case had already passed Helio admin-proof and connector-authentication checks. This supported treating external-system authority as a **separate readiness input** from Helio admin proof and connector authentication. It did not establish that all onboarding or support demand was broken.

## What the original eight cases did and did not justify — historical boundary
- **Did justify:** a narrow, prospective diagnostic to distinguish external authority from product guidance and quantify their support burden after admission.
- **Did not justify:** an intake-question or eligibility change; changes to live admission, pending-state, or assisted-routing rules; lifecycle changes; staffing changes; or a broad onboarding rebuild.
- Preserve existing live operating rules while the diagnostic runs. The original eight cases alone did not establish prevalence, a general cause, or the remedy.

## Reuse note
Reuse the method structure only as a historical template.
